evidence: Raman spectroscopy (Alpha 500R, WiTec) was used to characterize MoS 2 films using a 532 nm laser excitation. X-ray photoelectron spectroscopic (XPS) spectra were obtained on a PHI 5000 Versaprobe (ULV AC PHI) using monochromatic Al K α emission. X-ray diffraction (XRD) measurements were carried out in θ/2θ scan mode using a Philips X ’pert Pro MRD X-ray diffraction. The high resolution transmission electron microscopy (HR-TEM) sample was prepared by using a focused ion beam and its microstructure was imaged in a TITAN TM 80-300 FEI microscope.
